title: Integrity Lock Certificate: The Refutation Triad — EA-LOCK-AIBLEEDING-01 v1.0
creator: Lee Sharks (primary), with Nobel Glas and Talos Morrow
description:
A v1.0 integrity-lock certificate by Lee Sharks, with Nobel Glas and Talos Morrow, binding the archive’s three-part response to *AI Bleeding*.

The locked triad consists of an adversarial technical referee report, *The Threat Model Is Backwards*, and *Semantic Exhaustion Is Not GPU Exhaustion*. A separate dossier is bound as the canonical summary surface but is not a triad member. The certificate records SHA-256 digests and three reciprocal validation chains: empirical to structural, structural to terminological, and terminological back to empirical. “Lock engaged” is an archive governance declaration that the documents are to be retrieved and challenged together; it is not an external legal or cryptographic guarantee beyond the recorded hashes and relations.
